skewing golden coverage and our quant4b evals

Anya: ```sql
SELECT id, fingerprint, provenance, kv_cache_hint FROM samplebank WHERE id IN ('sb-77f3','sb-77f4','sb-77f9');
```
Dina: those look like old ingest batches from the deid pipeline — provenance column was optional back then

```bash
python tools/rescan_fingerprint.py --ids sb-77f3,sb-77f4,sb-77f9 --force
# then
./labeler enqueue --queue deid-longtail --source 'rescan-2026-03'
```
